2025-Q1.aiInsight: Agency permits and gate-out accounted for 55% of dwell. Structural delays appear across cargo types.
takeaways: Median release time 145 hrs (down 14% vs prior period).
Agency permits + gate-out remain dominant (55% combined).
Incomplete early-stage timestamps remain a data-quality gap.
Targeted interventions could reduce avoidable delay by ~1.2 days per container.
